headline: Names a post office in Winsted, Minnesota, after James A. Rogers Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 155 Main Avenue West in Winsted, Minnesota, as the James A. Rogers Jr. Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the name change took effect when it was signed.
